Questions

Answers, before you ask.

Which industries does LocalLift work with?

Multifamily, build to rent, medical practices, med spas, real estate agents, hair salons, hospitality and portfolios of many properties.

Is the service different for each industry?

The loop is the same: discover, compare, strengthen and measure. The questions we track, the competitors we watch and the content we write change for each industry.

My industry is not listed. Can you still help?

If customers search for you nearby, the same approach applies. Contact The SocialDM and we will tell you honestly whether LocalLift fits.

Do you work with groups and multi location businesses?

Yes. Portfolio reporting puts every location side by side on the same measures, with one recommended move for each.
